title: Authentication and Session Validation
description: Validate login, logout, MFA, recovery, expiry, refresh, and invalid-session behavior with durable evidence.
setup_prompt: Use Authentication and Session Validation with my browser foundation. Preserve my authentication provider and policies, create only authorized scenarios, run them from controlled contexts, and retain redacted video and console/network evidence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized test actors and account ownership
Lockout, recovery, MFA, and mutation limits

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Run repeatable authentication scenarios in controlled browser contexts

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate authorized authentication states and collect supported diagnostics

recommended_tools.name: Identity-provider MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Use an explicitly configured provider integration for approved setup or evidence
